text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back, this ballet music.
...To think I'd get to hear it on a music show, of all places."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I couldn't get this jeté right and practiced it over and over, didn't I? ...~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, frolicking with the music, are we?
This is... ballet music, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Shion-san, care to have a session with me?
I want to feel your expression more and more!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? N-No way.
I've... always been pretty bad at
artistic expression...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "That can't be true. You were just moving your body to the music earlier, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Music is something to enjoy from the heart.
Now, go ahead and play as you feel!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~♪
Feel free to join in whenever you like.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...Just follow my heart...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(A song I danced to often in ballet. All I wished for
was to dance beautifully. To leap gracefully.
...If that's the case—!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
With the same fiery heart from back then!
I'm gonna play my heart out, ssul!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ! Nice, keep that up...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, I'm sorry.
I guess that really was unreasonable...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Bravissimo!!
Such supreme passione, Shion-san!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
You mean what I just said!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. Such an earnest, devoted performance.
That overflowing passion resonated straight into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It felt as if the days you spent with ballet music were rushing through my mind.
...It's truly a music that only you could play.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Only I can play this melody...
Fufu...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: “I see... Letting your raw feelings clash. There are times when that's okay too...”

Perhaps because she had stepped into new territory,
from that day forward, Win Variation's running became even sharper.
